title: Implementation and evaluation of the effectiveness of the ResQ-Care questionnaire in the professional counseling context
summary: The aim of the project is to investigate whether the ResQ-Care questionnaire can be used in a counseling context to identify particularly vulnerable family caregivers at an early stage. Furthermore, we will examine whether the counseling process differs between the intervention and control group and whether individualized counseling based on the results of the ResQ-Care questionnaire leads to better health-related outcomes for family caregivers 6 months later. In addition, the feasibility and acceptance of the questionnaire will be investigated.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria for care support center/counseling center: regular contact with caregivers and provision of consultations
Inclusion criteria for family caregivers: inclusion before first (max. second)
counseling, self-identification as a relative, caregiver of a person in need of care.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria for care support center/counseling center: no contact with caregivers, no provision of consultations

Exclusion criteria for family caregivers: already received two consultations, no family member in need of care in the environment
